business_problem: serve analytics APIs and large-scale job-market insights faster and at lower total cost as the company grew to millions of employers and job seeker profiles.
solution_summary: Indeed uses Snowflake on Snowflake to serve analytics apis and large-scale job-market insights faster and at lower total cost as the company grew to millions of employers and job seeker profiles. Employer, job seeker, salary, and marketplace activity data are consolidated on Snowflake to power Indeed analytics APIs and internal insight workloads. Indeed uses the platform to manage interactive analytical tables and warehouse compute efficiently so large query workloads can execute faster at lower cost. The resulting analytics are surfaced through APIs and internal tools that help teams understand hiring activity and support faster product decisions for the job marketplace. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and downstream access on one governed platform reduces data copying, simplifies operations, and gives teams a single trusted operating view for analytics and AI.
